# PR2: in-module Go-only replace ./sub is copied to the ejected output.
# The ejected go.mod must reference the copied ./sub in the output tree,
# not point back into the original disposable source directory.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd lapp
logos run .
stdout '^internal-sub-ok$'
cp stdout $WORK/want-stdout.txt

logos eject -o $WORK/out
exists $WORK/out/main.go
exists $WORK/out/go.mod
exists $WORK/out/sub/go.mod
exists $WORK/out/sub/sub.go

# Removing the original source directory proves the ejected module is
# self-contained and does not point back into the disposable source tree.
cd ..
exists lapp
rm lapp
! exists lapp

cd $WORK/out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/want-stdout.txt

-- lapp/go.mod --
module example.com/lapp

go 1.27

require example.com/sub v1.0.0

replace example.com/sub v1.0.0 => ./sub

-- lapp/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/sub"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(sub.Msg())
}

-- lapp/sub/go.mod --
module example.com/sub

go 1.27

-- lapp/sub/sub.go --
package sub

// Msg reports the internal helper string.
func Msg() string {
	return "internal-sub-ok"
}
